classes.label: Internet keeps disconnecting
classes.description: Broadband connects but drops repeatedly, often at specific times of day.

classes.label: Internet is slow
classes.description: Connected, but speeds are well below the plan.

classes.label: Weak Wi-Fi in some rooms
classes.description: Wi-Fi is weak or unstable away from the router while wired or nearby devices work.

classes.label: Fiber box shows red LOS light
classes.description: Fiber ONT shows LOS (loss of optical signal); no internet at all.

classes.label: Internet down for the whole area
classes.description: Multiple premises, the building or the street have no service.

classes.label: Router has no power
classes.description: Router power light is off and the home internet is unavailable; equipment inspection may be required.

classes.label: Mobile data not working
classes.description: Phone has signal but mobile data does not load.

classes.label: Calls failing or not coming in
classes.description: Outgoing or incoming calls fail while other services may work.

classes.label: OTP / bank SMS not arriving
classes.description: Verification or bank messages do not arrive though normal SMS may work.

classes.label: No network while roaming abroad
classes.description: Phone cannot register on a partner network abroad.

classes.label: Cannot send text messages
classes.description: Outgoing SMS fails while incoming messages may still arrive.

classes.label: Phone hotspot has no internet
classes.description: Mobile data works on the phone but devices connected to its hotspot cannot browse.

classes.label: New / replacement SIM not activated
classes.description: SIM shows no service after activation; identity-verified provisioning may be needed.

classes.label: eSIM won't download
classes.description: eSIM QR code or profile download fails.

classes.label: SIM locked / PUK requested
classes.description: SIM is locked after incorrect PIN attempts and needs secure recovery.

classes.label: Number port is delayed
classes.description: Mobile number portability transfer not completed in the expected window.

classes.label: Charge I don't recognise
classes.description: Bill contains an unexpected or disputed charge.

classes.label: Payment not showing
classes.description: Customer paid but the account still shows dues.

classes.label: Plan change not reflected
classes.description: A confirmed plan change is missing from the account or bill.

classes.label: Recharge done but plan not active
classes.description: Prepaid recharge or renewal succeeded but the plan entitlement is missing.

classes.label: TV picture freezing / pixelating
classes.description: TV picture breaks up, freezes or pixelates on one or more channels.

classes.label: TV picture but no sound
classes.description: TV picture is visible but sound is missing on one or more channels.
